content.value: Explain the Chou-Fasman algorithm for secondary structure prediction. Assume a dataset (12) consists of 100000 residues. One-third of them are in helix conformation. Alanine is observed 8000 times. In the helix conformation, there are 5000 Alanine. Determine the propensity value of Alanine to form α-helix.
